data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Ioannes, meaning 'God is gracious' or 'God is merciful'. The name Jojo is a diminutive or pet form of John, which is derived from the Hebrew name Yochanan, meaning 'Yahweh is gracious'. The name Jojo carries the meaning “God is my Lord” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jojo usually hope their child will grow to embody god is my lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: ג'וג'ו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ג'וג'ו הוא שם שמקורו בשם העברי יוֹחָנָן (יוֹחָנָן), שפירושו 'ה' הוא חנן' או 'חנן ה''. השם התפתח דרך השם היווני Ἰωάννης (Ioánnēs) ושם הלטין Iohannes. השם ג'וג'ו משמש לעתים קרובות ככינוי חיבה או שם חיבה לנוצרים, והוא מייצג את הקשר עם האל ונותן החיים.

in_greek.name: Τζότζο
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ελεήμων και ζωοποιός
in_greek.long_meaning: Το Τζότζο είναι παραλλαγή του ονόματος Ιωάννης (Ioánnēs), που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι ελεήμων' ή 'ελεήμων ο Θεός'. Το όνομα προέρχεται από την Εβραϊκή λέξη יוֹחָנָן (יוֹחָנָן) και μεταφέρθηκε στην Ελλάδα μέσω της λατινικής μορφής Iohannes. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το Τζότζο συμβολίζει τη σχέση με τον Θεό και τη χαρά της πνευματικής新生.

in_latin.name: Jojo
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Jojo derivatum est ex nomine hebraeo יוֹחָנָן (יוֹחָנָן), quod significat 'Deus misericors' vel 'misericors Deus'. Per formam latinam Iohannes, nomen Jojo devenit in usu christiano, significans gratiam et donum Dei. Jojo est nomen quod connexionem cum Deo et vitam aeternam repraesentat.

in_english.name: Jojo
in_english.meaning: God is gracious and gives life
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jojo originates from the Hebrew name יוֹחָנָן (יוֹחָנָן), meaning 'God is gracious' or 'gracious God'. Through its Greek form Ἰωάννης (Ioánnēs) and Latin form Iohannes, Jojo became a popular name in Christian traditions. It symbolizes the connection with God, who is the giver of life and salvation. In modern usage, Jojo is often used as a term of endearment or a shortened form of names like John or Johanna.

The name Jojo carries with it rich cultural significance, particularly within Christian communities, representing familiarity with and reverence for important spiritual figures.
